out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment. Observed the sanitizing solution in the spray bottle for cleaning surfaces was mixed too strong. The concentration could not be measured. The CFM stated she mixes equal parts water and bleach.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. The EHS discussed and demonstrated the proper way to mix a bleach sanitizing solution. For the 1 liter spray bottle being used, one half teaspoon of bleach should be added. Verify the concentration using the appropriate test kit. CDI.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. The manager ordered an irreversible registering temperature indicator during the inspection. CDI.
